name: Uldaman

entrance.note: Two Badlands portals. Back door (north) 44.6, 12.1 is the steps-v2 run goto — Map Chamber / Archaedas. Front door (excavation) 65.2, 43.5 is the trogg cave. Horde hub is Kargath. Staff of Prehistoria is not a quest in dungeons.json, steps-v2, questie-db, or web/public/data/quests.json.

fromHubs: Kargath: fly Gorrik; Jarkal Mossmeld is in town (2.4, 46.1). Back door is a north ride to 44.6, 12.1; front excavation is 65.2, 43.5.
Rog'mar: fly Grakna -> Kargath (h4060: Fly Rog'mar -> Kargath).
Orgrimmar: pick up Necklace Recovery (2283) from Dran Droffers (59.5, 36.6), then zeppelin / fly toward Kargath.
Undercity: mage breadcrumb 1953 from Anastasia Hartwell (85.1, 10.0) and Reclaimed Treasures (2342) from Patrick Garrett (62.3, 48.6) before the Kargath flight.
travel.how: Fly to Kargath. Set hearth at Innkeeper Shul'kar (Badlands 2.82, 45.86) if turning in Jarkal. Use the back door (44.6, 12.1) for Archaedas / Platinum Discs / the mage orb; use the front door (65.2, 43.5) for troggs, the paladin remains, Tablet of Ryun'eh, fungus, and Garrett's treasure.

quests.name: Power Stones
quests.notes: Dentrium and An'Alleum Power Stones from Shadowforge dwarves inside. Catalog speedrun:true (3500 base). Rigglefuzz is not in Kargath.

quests.name: Solution to Doom
quests.notes: Tablet of Ryun'eh. Catalog insideDungeon:false and speedrun:false — front excavation, not the back door. Balanced only in steps-v2. Leads to 728 (Horde, not in this pack).

quests.name: Return to the Marsh
quests.notes: Mage breadcrumb for 1954. steps-v2 balanced only. QuestieDB breadcrumbFor 1954; also starts from Ursyn Ghull, Deino, and Alliance mage trainers. dungeons.json lists Anastasia and Uthel'nay.

quests.name: The Infernal Orb
quests.notes: Mage. Infernal Orb is outside Uldaman. dungeons.json anyOf [1953] and speedrun:false; QuestieDB has no required pre. steps-v2 still emits accept/turnin on speedrun.

quests.name: The Exorcism
quests.notes: Mage. Kill the Demon of the Orb at Tabetha. Catalog speedrun:false; steps-v2 balanced+speedrun. Unlocks 1956.

quests.name: Power in Uldaman
quests.notes: Mage. Obsidian Power Source from Archaedas — back door is the short path. Catalog speedrun:true. Leads to 1957 (not in this pack).

quests.name: Necklace Recovery
quests.notes: Shattered Necklace from troggs — front entrance. Chain order in data: 2283 -> 2284 -> 2318 -> 2338 -> 2339 -> 2340 -> 2341. Catalog speedrun:false (low XP); steps-v2 still on speedrun because 2341 is speedrun:true.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 2
quests.notes: Turn in on the paladin remains inside (front path). Accept 2318 from the same corpse. No outdoor coords. Catalog speedrun:false; steps-v2 balanced+speedrun.

quests.name: Uldaman Reagent Run
quests.notes: Magenta Fungus Caps. Catalog insideDungeon:false and speedrun:false — front cave / halls. Requires Badlands Reagent Run (2258) from the same NPC (overworld pack, not a dungeon step). Balanced only in steps-v2.

quests.name: Translating the Journal
quests.notes: Take the journal from the paladin remains (front path) to Jarkal in Kargath. Catalog speedrun:false (860 XP).

quests.name: Translating the Journal
quests.notes: Talk-only in Kargath. Catalog speedrun:false (345 XP). Unlocks 2339.

quests.name: Reclaimed Treasures
quests.notes: Garrett Family Treasure. Catalog insideDungeon:false and speedrun:false — front halls. Balanced only in steps-v2. Undercity pickup.

quests.name: Find the Gems and Power Source
quests.notes: Sapphire from Grimlok (inside, front path). Power Source from Archaedas (back door). Ruby and Topaz have empty droppedBy and insideDungeon:false in the catalog. Catalog speedrun:false; steps-v2 balanced+speedrun.

quests.name: Deliver the Gems
quests.notes: Kargath to Orgrimmar. Catalog speedrun:false (1850 XP).

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 3
quests.notes: Talk-only return to Jarkal. Catalog speedrun:true (5600 base). End of the necklace chain.

quests.name: Wild Leather Armor
quests.notes: Leatherworking 225. Thick Leather turn-in in Camp Mojache. In dungeons.json/README as a Uldaman prereq; no dungeons:uldaman:* steps. Not an Uldaman run objective.

quests.name: Wild Leather Shoulders
quests.notes: Leatherworking. Catalog selectionReason 'objective item drops in dungeon' for Thick Armor Kit and Wildvine with insideDungeon:true — those are crafted/gathered, not Uldaman drops. No steps-v2 ids.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.notes: Object in the Map Chamber after Archaedas — back door. Catalog speedrun:true. Unlocks 2280 (Horde). Staff of Prehistoria is not in the catalog; this is the in-data Map Chamber quest.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.notes: Take the discs to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff. Catalog speedrun:true (5250 base). Leads to 2440 (not in this pack).

prep.group: 5-player, dungeon levels 42-52; do not enter before 45 (runAt). Troggs and dwarves in mixed packs; earth elementals hit hard. Archaedas activates guardians in waves.
prep.hearth: Innkeeper Shul'kar, Kargath 2.82, 45.86 (Jarkal turn-ins), or keep Rog'mar (Innkeeper Toka 57.99, 45.1) if still on the 40-60 Riverglades hearth.
warnings: Two doors: front 65.2, 43.5 for 2283/2284/2318/709/2202/2342; back 44.6, 12.1 for 1956/2278/2280 and Archaedas on 2339. steps-v2 run goto is the back door.
Staff of Prehistoria is not present as a quest or item in the catalog, steps-v2, or questie-db.
2258 Badlands Reagent Run (Kargath overworld) is required before 2202.
Mage 1953-1956 is Tabetha in Dustwallow; skip unless Mage.
2854/2855 are Camp Mojache Leatherworking 225, not Uldaman objectives.

At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour. Kill XP inside dungeons is increased by 50%. If any party member would get no XP because the mobs are trivial to them, nobody in the party gets XP (Blizzard Forever hotfixes through 20 Nov 2026).
classQuests: Mage 1953/1954/1955/1956: breadcrumb to Tabetha, Infernal Orb and Exorcism at her farm, then Obsidian Power Source from Archaedas (back door).

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: h4060 treats Kargath as a short stop then flies out. Coyote Thieves, Badlands Reagent Run, buzzard wings, Broken Alliances (Boss Tho'grun), and Study of the Elements: Rock are the same-band overworld Uldaman at 45 replaces if you stay in the zone.
Camp Mojache east loop in h4060 (Woodpaw / Gordunni) sits in the same 40-45 band as an Uldaman runAt of 45.

sourceConflicts: Necklace chain 2283/2284/2318/2338/2339/2340: dungeons.json and README mark speedrun:false; steps-v2 emits them on balanced+speedrun because 2341 is speedrun:true.
Mage 1954/1955: dungeons.json/README speedrun:false; steps-v2 balanced+speedrun. 1953 is balanced-only in steps-v2.
1954 prerequisites: dungeons.json anyOf [1953]; QuestieDB has no required pre (1953 is breadcrumbFor 1954).

1953 givers: steps-v2 uses Anastasia Hartwell Undercity 85.1, 10.0; dungeons.json lists Anastasia and Uthel'nay; QuestieDB starts from Ursyn Ghull, Anastasia, Deino, and Alliance trainers; QuestieDB zoneSource is Thunder Bluff.
2339 ruby (7669) and topaz (7671) have empty droppedBy and insideDungeon:false in dungeons.json; sapphire is Grimlok inside; power source is Archaedas inside.
2854/2855 are in dungeons.json and README but have no dungeons:uldaman:* steps. 2855 is tagged 'objective item drops in dungeon' for Thick Armor Kit and Wildvine.
Staff of Prehistoria / Shaft of Tsol / Medallion of Gni'kiv are not in dungeons.json, steps-v2, content/questie-db, or web/public/data/quests.json.
Classic Era XP in dungeons.json; catalog notes Forever may halve dungeon-quest bonus XP (unofficial). Amounts here are Classic Era base.
notes: Horde-only pack. Pickup hub is Kargath in the Badlands, levels 38-45. Dungeons-off: Badlands, Swamp of Sorrows and Stranglethorn Vale. One quested clear; do not reset-farm. XP figures are Classic Era from dungeons.json / questie-db / web/public/data/quests.json.
